title: cyanus strictus
intro: Cyanus strictus, commonly known as Cornflower, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Cornflower include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a mild sedative. The bioactive constituents of Cyanus strictus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
